title: Runtime envelopes and deadlines
responsibility: Validates runtime response envelopes and applies a timeout to both yielded and thread-blocking calls.

inputs.name: runtimeResponse.value
inputs.description: Unknown value to inspect for ok true with an output property, or ok false with string error code/message.

inputs.name: runtimeResponseText.text
inputs.description: JSON text returned by a byte transport.

inputs.name: runtimeDeadline.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Milliseconds allowed for the call, measured from deadline creation.

outputs.name: runtimeResponse
outputs.description: Original valid envelope, or invalid-response failure explaining that the value is not an envelope.

outputs.name: runtimeResponseText
outputs.description: Validated parsed envelope, or invalid-response for non-JSON text.

outputs.name: runtimeDeadline
outputs.description: Deadline with an expired promise and settle method. The timer produces runtime-timeout; settle clears it and rejects a result arriving strictly after the elapsed limit, including work that blocked the timer.
